context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss about visionary leadership
purpose: Teach: 資材/教諭/優良/作動/強要/超越/預言/ウォール

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 君が社長になってから、優良な人材が次々と辞めていると聞いたよ。
lines.en: I heard that excellent talent has been leaving one after another since you became president.
lines.style: Gentle but pointed elder statesman tone, slow measured delivery

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ええ、コスト削減で資材の調達先を変えたら、現場が反発しまして…。
lines.en: Yes, when I changed material suppliers for cost reduction, the field workers pushed back...
lines.style: Defensive younger executive, slightly apologetic with trailing hesitation

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 数字だけ見て指示を強要しても、人は動かん。私の父は高校教諭だったが、よく言っていたよ。
lines.en: Even if you force orders looking only at numbers, people won't move. My father was a high school teacher, and he often said this.
lines.style: Reflective, drawing on family wisdom with firm conviction

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なんとおっしゃっていたんですか。
lines.style: Earnest curious question, leaning in respectfully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 「真のリーダーは預言者のように、目先の利益を超越したビジョンを語れ」とね。ウォール街の流儀じゃ通用せんよ。
lines.en: 'A true leader, like a prophet, must speak a vision that transcends short-term profit.' Wall Street's way won't work here.
lines.style: Quoting wisdom with weight, dismissive of Western finance culture

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 確かに、四半期の数字ばかり追って、機械が作動するように人を扱っていた気がします。
lines.en: Indeed, I feel I've been chasing only quarterly numbers and treating people like machines that just operate.
lines.style: Self-aware confession, voice softening with realization

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 気づけたなら、まだ間に合う。社員に夢を見せられる経営者に成るんだ。
lines.en: If you've noticed, there's still time. Become an executive who can show employees a dream.
lines.style: Warm encouraging close where a mentor passes the torch onward

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい、明日の役員会で、まず現場の声を聞くところから始めます。
lines.en: Yes, at tomorrow's board meeting, I'll start by listening to the voices on the floor.
lines.style: Renewed determination, crisp respectful commitment, tone matching the moment with quiet honesty
